dedupe_keys.name: annual oil palm plantation maps in malaysia and indonesia from 2001 to 2016

description: Tsinghua University and LSCE publish annual maps of oil-palm plantations in Malaysia and Indonesia for 2001–2016. The dataset represents both plantation expansion and shrinkage. Zenodo supplies two RAR data packages and a DOCX instruction file, with open and free access under CC-BY-4.0. The landing description reports a resolution of 100 but omits its unit, so that value is not converted to metres in this draft. The authors warn that post-processing overestimates changes in the final 2016 map and recommend excluding that year from further analysis. File encodings and the detailed plantation-class definitions were not inspected. These maps could support agricultural supply-area, logistics-demand or land-change scenarios linked to food-processing infrastructure. They complement data-indonesia-industrial-smallholder-oil-palm-expansion-2001-2019 with a different regional time series. Classification differences, the last-year artefact and absence of yield information limit their use as direct measures of annual production or processing demand.
